notes.decision: Extend the Signal Dark palette with a second muted text color
notes.did: Added --muted-text #8b93a1 for all readable secondary text; kept --muted #6b7280 for non-text chrome only
notes.why: #6b7280 on #0c0e12 measures 4.0:1 and on #14171d 3.7:1 — below the 4.5:1 text threshold enforced on rendered output
notes.traded: Two muted tokens to maintain instead of one; designers must pick the right one per use
notes.instead: Leaving #6b7280 as body/secondary text would fail the enforced contrast check
notes.basis: Measured WCAG ratios; workspace design checks require >=4.5:1 for text

notes.decision: Square the radii: dock pill 16px->12px visual language, controls/menu to 4px
notes.did: Radius tokens set to 4px (control) and 8px (window/popup); the dock pill drawn at 12px as the single soft exception so it still reads as a floating pill
notes.why: Signal Dark signature is a dense console; fully-square pill looked like a toolbar, not a dock
notes.traded: One radius value (12px) lives outside the 4px token — mild inconsistency, visible only on the pill
notes.instead: 4px everywhere read as a toolbar strip, not a dock; 16px read too bubbly for a console aesthetic
notes.basis: Signal Dark shape spec (--radius 4px) vs. platform convention that a dock floats

notes.decision: Add a 1px divider between pinned and running-only icon groups
notes.did: Drew a hairline separator before the first unpinned-running row in the dock pill
notes.why: The current ListView renders both groups indistinguishable; users cannot see why some icons are draggable and others are not
notes.traded: One extra painted element; breaks the dead-flat icon row with a rule
notes.instead: Could use spacing only, but a hairline reads better at 26px thickness and costs nothing
notes.basis: DockView: model order is pinned-then-running; only pinned rows are reorderable

notes.decision: Propose tooltip/mono window-count caption on icon hover
notes.did: Icon title attribute shown in walkthrough notes; hover state adds outline + fill
notes.why: DockIcon exposes no title text today; window count is only visible via right-click
notes.traded: New element to implement in QML if accepted
notes.instead: Status quo: count only inside the context menu, which hides information behind a click

notes.decision: Propose one-line empty-dock hint instead of a bare 2px pill
notes.did: Empty state draws a mono 'no apps — right-click → Dock settings to pin' cell
notes.why: With zero rows the dock collapses to a margin-only sliver users cannot discover
notes.traded: New visible element where the app currently shows nothing
notes.instead: Current behavior: dock shrinks to an invisible 2px pill — functional but undiscoverable

notes.decision: Keep settings as one scrolling column; add scrollbar-affordance fade + scroll cue
notes.did: Bottom fade gradient with 'scroll' cue on the 480x640 window
notes.why: PINNED APPS sits below the fold; no affordance exists today
notes.traded: Slight decorative element at the bottom edge
notes.instead: Tabs would break the dense single-column console feel and add navigation chrome
notes.basis: SettingsWindow.qml uses one Flickable column; minimumSize allows 480px height

notes.decision: Bar widget keeps 12px raster icons at 26px bar height — no size change
notes.did: Drew widget at Style.space(12) icon / 26px slot, optically centered
notes.why: Bar contract is the host's metric; the widget must not re-size itself
notes.traded: Icons are small (12px) — inherent to Omarchy bar density, not a choice here
notes.instead: Larger icons would overflow the bar and break the optical centering the thickness property exists for

notes.decision: Model the three hosts as state toggles, not separate screens
notes.did: §4 covers context-menu host differences (Quit row, labels); §5 gains a standalone state that hides 'Show in' and swaps the helptext; §8 stays a separate screen because it is a different host surface
notes.why: Behavior (flows, data, conditions like desktopId !== '') is identical across hosts — only which rows render changes; duplicating screens would imply different flows
notes.traded: Reviewers must toggle states to see every host — one click per variant
notes.instead: Three separate catalog entries would triple the rail for one window
notes.basis: ContextMenu visible-conditions on canQuit/displayMode; SettingsWindow activeDisplayMode

notes.decision: Ship Signal Dark as the default palette read from a W3C token file, with host-theme colors as opt-in
notes.did: services/signal-dark.tokens.json holds the tokens; Theme.qml parses it into the existing theme.* roles; config.palette='signal'|'omarchy' + a Palette segmented row in settings switches sources; property defaults encode Signal Dark so a missing file degrades to the same palette
notes.why: The design mandates the exact Signal Dark hexes; leaving colors to the host colors.toml made the palette theme-dependent
notes.traded: New config key, a new settings row, and a second colors.toml code path (kept, guarded behind palette)
notes.instead: Hard-coding hexes inside Theme.qml — rejected: tokens must live in the W3C JSON source
notes.basis: Design-system brief requires referencing tokens; Omarchy integration preserved via palette='omarchy'
